title: Totem of Keep Inventory
description: Adds a Totem that is consumed upon death to save your inventory.
body: This is a mod that saves your inventory upon death by consuming a Totem of Keep Inventory. I created this mod as an in-between keep inventory and losing everything. It works with modded items and also saves items in your Curios and Trinkets slots. The totem costs 2 diamonds 3 iron and 4 chests.
